title: Battle of Ibiraocaí
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Ibiraocaí", at revision 1370443517, opens: "The Battle of Ibiraocaí, was fought between an army of the United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves and the forces of José Gervasio Artigas commanded by José Antonio Berdún. The Luso-Brazilians were victorious." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5722534, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1816 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
